newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RTZ-CRA reports higher copper output in 1996.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RTZ-CRA reports higher copper output in 1996.

text.p: Anglo-American mining group RTZ-CRA said on Wednesday its copper mine production rose 19 percent in 1996 compared with 1995.

The group said in its fourth quarter production report that aluminium production rose nine percent during the year while iron ore output rose nine percent, although iron ore sales were down six percent. The group's share of gold production for the year was a record 1.95 million ounces, the report said.

Copper mine production in the fourth quarter rose 33 percent to 201,700 tonnes, taking 1996 output to 759,200 tonnes, the company said. Refined copper production grew 32 percent to 40,400 tonnes in the final quarter, bringing full year output to 134,900 tonnes, flat on 1995.

The company's troubled Kennecott flash smelting furnace and flash converting furnace at the Bingham Canyon Utah mine operated at 89 percent and 51 percent of design capacity, respectively in the month of December.
Fourth quarter aluminium output rose 11 percent to 102,700 tonnes, bringing year output to 386,500 tonnes, figures show.
Mined gold output climbed 34 percent in the quarter to 534,000 ounces resulting in full year output of 1.95 million ounces.

Quarterly output of refined gold rose 50 percent to 30,000 ounces, while full year output fell 26 percent to 88,000 ounces. Iron ore production in the fourth quarter rose five percent to 13.89 million tonnes against the corresponding 1995 period, taking the 1996 total to 55 million tonnes
Fourth quarter coal output reached 18.42 million tonnes, up 13 percent for a 1996 total of 67.8 million tonnes.
Borate production in the final quarer declined seven percent to 139,000 tonnes and fell two percent to 534,000 tonnes for the year, when compared to corresponding periods of 1995.
Fourth quarter production of diamonds fell 21 percent to 5.6 million carats but showed an overall increase of five percent for the year of 25.07 million carats.
Uranium production totalled 450 tonnes in the December quarter, down five percent, while full year output grew 33 percent to 1,978 tonnes.
RTZ-CRA produced 4.35 million ounces of silver in the latest quarter, up 89 percent, and 12.2 million ouncs for 1996, a rise of 24 percent.
